onboarding.welcome_desc: Never miss a tax deadline. Setup takes about 2 minutes.
onboarding.org_type_desc: This will determine which taxes we show you.
onboarding.org_llc_hint: LLC, JSC, State-owned enterprise, Non-profit, etc.
onboarding.org_farm_hint: With or without legal entity formation
onboarding.org_acct_hint: I manage accounting for multiple organisations
onboarding.accountant_info: We'll set up a general interface for you. After logging into the dashboard, you can add client organisations — for each, go through a short setup (type → regime → employees → assets).
onboarding.regime_vat_hint: Turnover > 1 billion UZS or voluntary. You pay VAT and income tax.
onboarding.regime_turnover_hint: Turnover up to 1 billion UZS. Single turnover tax instead of VAT and income tax.
onboarding.regime_note: If registered as a VAT payer — choose VAT. Otherwise — turnover tax. Can be changed later in settings.
onboarding.employees_desc: Affects payroll taxes in the calendar.
onboarding.emp_yes_hint: Personal income tax, social tax, INPS — by the 15th of each month.
onboarding.emp_no_hint: Payroll taxes will not be shown.
onboarding.ie_note_text: social tax of at least 1 BRV/month is mandatory even without employees (Art. 408 TC).
onboarding.assets_farm_desc: Land and water are typical for dehkan farms — remove what doesn't apply.
onboarding.assets_desc: Check everything that applies to you. If nothing — just click Next.
onboarding.asset_property_hint: Buildings, equipment, transport. Property tax + advances.
onboarding.asset_land_ag_hint: Land tax: by September 1 — 30%, by December 1 — remainder.
onboarding.activities_desc: Most people need nothing here. If unsure — click Next.
onboarding.act_nonresident_hint: Tax on non-resident income, Art. 355 TC.
onboarding.act_dividends_hint: Payment no later than the payment date, Art. 345 TC.
onboarding.act_alcohol_title: Retail sale of alcohol, beer or tobacco
onboarding.act_alcohol_hint: Fees, Art. 460 TC. Prepayment by the 10th.
onboarding.act_highrev_hint: Monthly income tax advances, Art. 340 TC.
onboarding.act_kkt_hint: Correction of technical errors in receipts.
onboarding.pension_desc: Applies to a small number of organisations. If unsure — leave empty.
onboarding.pension_disabled_title: An employee raising a child with disability under 16
onboarding.pension_disabled_hint: Benefit application by the 10th of the following month (Cabinet Resolution #661).
onboarding.pension_loss_title: Pensions assigned for loss of breadwinner or occupational injury
onboarding.pension_loss_hint: Payment of funds by the 25th (Cabinet Resolution #661, item 32).
onboarding.reminders_desc: Set it up as you like.
onboarding.days_label: How many days before to remind
onboarding.notifications_note: In-app notifications — free for everyone. Telegram notifications and Google Calendar sync — in the Pro plan.
onboarding.done_title: Done! Your calendar is set up.
onboarding.done_desc: Based on your data, we've selected relevant tax events.
onboarding.selfemployed_note: As self-employed, you can voluntarily pay social tax (1 BRV/year) to accrue work experience.
onboarding.treki_error: An error occurred. Please try again.
onboarding.pro_upgrade_title: Unlock the full power of Trek
onboarding.pro_upgrade_desc: Telegram alerts, Google Calendar sync, AI assistant, and data export.
onboarding.treki_welcome: Hello! I am Treki — your tax assistant. Ask me anything about setup or Uzbek taxes.
